title: DARPA N3 brain-machine interface program

tellings.quote: That year DARPA launched a program called N3, [music] next generation non-surgical neurotechnology.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in 2018 DARPA, the Pentagon's agency for advanced research, launched a program called N3, short for next generation non-surgical neurotechnology. He tells it as part of a story about the military working on ways to link brains and machines without surgery.
